note: Literature confirms Iwasawa et al. 2019 reported 5 individuals across 4 families with recurrent missense variants presenting with intellectual disability, while broader cohort studies confirm a variable cognitive spectrum.

evidence.text: Iwasawa et al. identified 5 individuals from 4 families with recurrent de novo missense variants in MAPK8IP3, with intellectual disability among the core clinical phenotype features.

source.title: Recurrent de novo MAPK8IP3 variants cause neurological ...
source.quote: We identified 5 individuals from four families with recurrent de novo variants c.1732C>T (p.Arg578Cys) and c.3436C>T (p.Arg1146Cys) in MAPK8IP3. The core phenotype includes spastic diplegia, intellectual disability, cerebral atrophy, and corpus callosum hypoplasia.

evidence.text: Cognitive performance across individuals with heterozygous pathogenic MAPK8IP3 variants exhibits a broad spectrum, with a mean DAS-II General Conceptual Ability score of 62.5 +/- 26.5.

source.title: Comprehensive Clinical Characteristics, Longitudinal Adaptive Functioning, and Electroencephalogram Activity in MAPK8IP3‐Related Neurodevelopmental Disorder
source.quote: The mean DAS-II General Conceptual Ability score was 62.5 ± 26.5.
